page.overview:
Who is Malind Nachenin?

Malind Nachenin is an Aes Sedai and for a while a rebel Sitter of the Green Ajah.

Malind is a slightly plump and pretty Kandori with a round face, full smiling lips, and fierce, dark eyes.

Malind is of low average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She would be unable to Travel without linking with another channeler.

Malind is 59 years old. She was born in the year and went to the White Tower in 957 NE. After spending twelve years as Novice and eleven as Accepted she was raised to the shawl in the year 980 NE.
